rule: the SMALLEST failing span per defect file, clustered
method: for every file the differential found Julia accepts and tree-sitter rejects, collect all ERROR nodes and keep the smallest by byte span; normalise it (identifiers to X, literals to S/N) and cluster. The FIRST error is the wrong thing to localise on: when a construct wrecks a region the ERROR node often starts at the top of the file, so 121 of 185 defect files pointed at line 1 and clustering produced 15 clusters of which 9 were the Julia licence header.
bias: a construct that wrecks a LARGE region hides every smaller error inside it, so a file whose only damage is one file-wide span still yields a large span here. Cluster counts are therefore per-shape incidences, not per-construct prevalence.
